species: The selected protein spots were manually excised from gels stained with Coomassie Brilliant Blue G250 (Merck) and identified by Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) at the University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU) proteomics service, SGIker, following the method described by Areitio et al., with some modifications.
cell_type: Five C. auris isolates belonging to the clade III from bloodstream infections were used in this study
disease_state: Five C. auris isolates belonging to the clade III from bloodstream infections were used in this study
sample_source: Five C. auris isolates belonging to the clade III from bloodstream infections were used in this study
strain: Total protein and CWAP were extracted independently from C. auris CECT 13225, following the methodologies described by Areitio et al. and Pitarch et al., respectively.
